This article is a stub. Spectrum Aquatics is a starting platform and pool equipment maker in
Missoula, Montana, a division of PlayCore like Colorado Time Systems, and the maker of the
[Fusion Starting Platform](../equipment/swimming/starting-blocks/fusion-starting-platform.md)
with its built-in CTS relay platform.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
